title: game/data/biomes.json: the map generator's recipes, one per biome (map generator track MG-1)

name.description: shown in the Studio's biome picker

climate.description: the kind of weather it gets: a climate of logic/weather.js CLIMATE_WEATHER_ODDS (a run's forecast rolls from it; RL-6)

pool.description: the Billies a run node of this biome meets: a pool of pools.json (its species only; the run sets the levels; RL-7)

battleStage.description: where a run node's battles are drawn: a stage of battleStages.json (RL-7)

mood.description: a run node's colour grade: a mood of moods.json (RL-7)

ground.description: ground letters (scenery.json terrains): the base, patches (letter: share 0-1), and the ground by a path (verge), in clearings (floor), round water (bank), on cliffs and scree (rock), and tall grass (tall, where encounters are)

water.description: the water kind of its ponds and streams (walk/water-data.js kinds)

plants.description: plants this biome favours: the wild growth (the grow-wild rules) picks these more often

tall.description: the props drawn in tall grass

look.description: scene look keys copied onto a generated scene (sky, haze, hazeD, amb, tint, wind, grassCol, rays, far, farH, flatFar)

from.description: the hand-built place this recipe was first taken from (for reference)
